description: Submit the host conversation AI recommendation for a pending Analysis Studio request. App code validates every variable name, type, category count and role conflict before the web form can apply it. This does not confirm or run the analysis.

features.description: Predictor/comparison variables. Use only for correlation, regression, ml or causal. Include the main regression exposure here.

group.description: Grouping/column variable. Use only for mean_difference, group_comparison or crosstab.

outcome.description: Result variable. Required for every supported analysis task.

positive_value.description: Positive class/treatment value. Use only for ml or causal.

treatment.description: Binary treatment variable. Use only for causal analysis; regression exposures belong in features.

weight.description: Optional numeric survey or analytic weight.

name: analysis_submit_analysis_recommendation
